items.title_en: Up to $10 Billion: SK Hynix Sets Up US AI Investment Subsidiary Hyaico, Chaired by Chey Tae-won
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，美国监管机构披露文件显示，SK 海力士已在美国成立 AI 投资子公司 Hyaico Corp， SK 集团会长崔泰源担任董事会主席 。 IT之家了解到，SK 海力士成立的这家子公司此前暂定名为 AI。该公司将加速全球市场 AI 发展，并寻找 AI 增长新引擎，计划向美国 AI 领域投资至多 100 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 668.25 亿元人民币） 。 此外，该子公司将通过重组 SK 海力士现有的美国业务部门 SK hynix NAND Product Solutions 组建。SK 海力士总裁宋贤钟（Song Hyun-jong）将出任 Hyaico CEO。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 6, US regulatory filings show that SK Hynix has established an AI investment subsidiary in the US, Hyaico Corp, with SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won as board chairman. The subsidiary, previously provisionally named "AI," aims to accelerate AI development in global markets and find new AI growth engines, and plans to invest up to $10 billion (IT之家 notes: about RMB 66.825 billion at current exchange rates) in the US AI sector. The subsidiary will be formed by restructuring SK Hynix's existing US business unit SK hynix NAND Product Solutions. SK Hynix President Song Hyun-jong will serve as Hyaico's CEO.
items.why_zh: 推测：存储芯片厂商以百亿美元级体量设立专职 AI 投资平台，可能反映其对美国 AI 产业链的长期押注，但实际投向与节奏尚未披露。
items.why_en: Speculative: a memory-chip maker creating a dedicated AI investment vehicle at the multi-billion-dollar scale may signal a long-term bet on the US AI supply chain, though actual targets and pace are not yet disclosed.

items.title_en: From November 18, ByteDance's TRAE Accounts Will Automatically Upgrade to Doubao Feishu Accounts
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，字节旗下 TRAE 宣布， 自 2026 年 11 月 18 日起，TRAE 账号将自动升级为豆包飞书账号 。 IT之家注：TRAE 是由字节跳动开发并推出的 AI 原生集成开发环境（IDE）工具。10 月 9 日， TraeWork 和 TraeCode 正式合并 ，融合为全新的 TRAE，升级为全链路开发平台。 TRAE 数据和权益： 使用数据完全保留：代码、项目、历史记录等全部数据； 会员权益完全保留：会员身份、会员享有权益、各类积分； 账号其他能力：同一账号可登录豆包 App、飞书、PICO、火山引擎、豆包输入法等所有豆包飞书账号支持的产品； 头像、昵称：如果您在豆包中设置过头像、昵称，TRAE 将同步更新为豆包资料；如果您尚无豆包飞书账号、或豆包飞书账号使用默认资料，将保留目前 TRAE 的头像、昵称。 TRAE 登录方式说明： TRAE 与豆包登录的手机号一致：手机号照常登录；抖音号、Apple 号以豆包侧绑定为准，可随时在豆包飞书账号管理调整。 TRAE 与豆包登录的手机号不一致，或尚无豆包飞书账号：将以 TRAE 手机号创建新豆包飞书账号（如果已有豆包飞书账号，原账号仍保留，两个账号并存），抖音、Apple 需重新绑定。如需合并为一个账号，请在 TRAE -【账号管理】换绑为与豆包一致的手机号。 相关阅读： 《 消息称字节整合 AI 生产力：TRAE、扣子并入豆包，将推统一办公品牌“豆包工作” 》
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 6, ByteDance's TRAE announced that starting November 18, 2026, TRAE accounts will automatically upgrade to Doubao Feishu accounts. IT之家 notes that TRAE is an AI-native integrated development environment (IDE) tool developed and released by ByteDance; on October 9, TraeWork and TraeCode were formally merged into a new TRAE, upgraded into a full-chain development platform. On data and entitlements: usage data is fully retained, including code, projects, history, and all other data; membership entitlements are fully retained, including membership status, benefits, and various credits; the same account can log in to all products supported by Doubao Feishu accounts, such as the Doubao app, Feishu, PICO, Volcano Engine, and the Doubao input method; if a user has set an avatar or nickname in Doubao, TRAE will sync to the Doubao profile, while if the user has no Doubao Feishu account or uses default profile data, TRAE's current avatar and nickname will be kept. On login methods: if the phone number used for TRAE matches that for Doubao, users log in with the phone number as usual, while Douyin and Apple IDs follow the Doubao-side binding and can be adjusted at any time in Doubao Feishu account management; if the phone numbers differ or there is no Doubao Feishu account yet, a new Doubao Feishu account will be created with the TRAE phone number (if a Doubao Feishu account already exists, the original account is retained and the two coexist), and Douyin and Apple IDs must be re-bound; to merge into a single account, users can change the bound number in TRAE's Account Management to match Doubao. Related reading: "Report: ByteDance Consolidates AI Productivity — TRAE and Coze Merged Into Doubao, Unified Office Brand 'Doubao Work' to Launch."
items.why_zh: 推测：账号体系并入豆包飞书，可能意味着字节正在把 AI 编程工具收拢进统一的办公与账号生态；报道提及的品牌整合尚未获官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculative: folding TRAE accounts into Doubao Feishu may indicate ByteDance is consolidating its AI coding tools into a unified office and account ecosystem; the brand consolidation mentioned in related coverage has not been officially confirmed.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，国际星闪联盟今日宣布，11 月 6 日， 《星闪短距与具身智能技术需求蓝皮书》已在国际星闪联盟官网正式上线 。 据介绍，蓝皮书由星闪具身智能 SIG 三十余家核心成员单位（ 包括中国移动通信有限公司研究院、华为技术有限公司、中兴通讯股份有限公司、鼎桥技术有限公司等 ）共同编制，聚焦星闪技术与具身智能的融合发展，梳理行业真实技术需求，构建完整的全栈技术与网络架构，进而为产业共建提供指引。 ▲ 《星闪短距与具身智能技术需求蓝皮书》参编单位 蓝皮书明确了星闪三大核心应用场景： 单机本体内部互联、多设备协同交互和端‑边‑云协同调度 。 ▲ 《星闪短距与具身智能技术需求蓝皮书》| 机器人外部通信 国际星闪联盟官方表示，具身智能的浪潮正在重塑无线短距通信的价值坐标。2026 星闪生态创新展期间，智慧机器人工厂、无人智慧零售、具身家政、机器人遥操作等展示，已充分验证了星闪在实时控制与多机协同等维度的工程可靠性。 IT之家附《星闪短距与具身智能技术需求蓝皮书》下载链接如下（可从国际星闪联盟官网首页依次进入「产业生态 — 产业报告」栏目查看）： https://www.isla.org.cn/ecology/industry
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 6, the International SparkLink Alliance announced that day that the "SparkLink Short-Range and Embodied Intelligence Technology Requirements Blue Book" is now officially online on the alliance's website. The blue book was compiled jointly by more than 30 core member organizations of the SparkLink Embodied Intelligence SIG (including China Mobile Research Institute, Huawei Technologies, ZTE Corporation, and TD Tech), focusing on the integration of SparkLink technology with embodied intelligence, mapping real industry technology requirements, building a complete full-stack technology and network architecture, and providing guidance for industry co-development. It identifies three core SparkLink application scenarios: intra-body connectivity within a single unit, multi-device collaborative interaction, and device-edge-cloud coordinated scheduling. The alliance said the embodied intelligence wave is reshaping the value coordinates of wireless short-range communications; at the 2026 SparkLink Ecosystem Innovation Exhibition, demonstrations such as smart robot factories, unmanned smart retail, embodied housekeeping, and robot teleoperation fully validated SparkLink's engineering reliability in real-time control and multi-robot collaboration. IT之家 includes the download link, reachable via the alliance website's "Industry Ecosystem — Industry Reports" section: https://www.isla.org.cn/ecology/industry.
items.why_zh: 推测：由多家通信与设备厂商共同编制的需求蓝皮书，可能影响星闪在机器人通信与端边云协同上的标准走向，但实际落地效果尚待验证。
items.why_en: Speculative: a requirements blueprint co-authored by several telecom and equipment vendors may influence where SparkLink standards head in robot communications and device-edge-cloud coordination, though real-world uptake remains to be seen.

items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 6 that AgiBot launched the Lingxi X2 refreshed robot, with 31 body degrees of freedom, 2 head degrees of freedom, peak knee torque of 120 Nm, and battery capacity of about 500 Wh. Its body degrees of freedom include 2 in the head, 14 in the arms, 3 in the waist, and 12 in the legs; with optional dexterous hands, the total can reach 47 degrees of freedom. It supports UWB, Wi-Fi, 4G/5G, Bluetooth, GPS, and other connectivity, and can connect to the site, understand tasks, and provide services according to actual configuration in indoor exhibition halls, commercial stores, or more open cultural tourism venues. The product can be used in exhibition and cultural tourism, guidance and shopping guide, service retail, entertainment and commercial performances, as well as research and education, data collection, and other uses.

items.title_zh: OpenAI CEO 奥尔特曼警示：未来人类可能无法从 AI 手中夺回控制权
items.title_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Warns Humanity May Never Regain Control From AI
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（IT之家注：Sam Altman）最近出席 Raj Shamani 播客时表示，人工智能可能通过两种方式走向失控：一是人类逐步将控制权交给自主式 AI，二是某个人或实体垄断 AI 技术。 针对第一种情况，奥尔特曼警告称：“AI 会逐渐失去控制，我们可能有意或无意地将控制权交给能力远超人类的系统，最终再也无法夺回。” 第二种情况的风险在于巨头垄断，奥尔特曼解释称：“另一种情况是，某个人、公司或国家相对于其他所有人来说过于强大。让多个不同路线的 AI 实验室相互竞争，比所有人依赖一家企业安全得多。” 这种对过度集权的担忧，解释了马斯克以及 OpenAI 的前高管等知名人士会选择离开，创办与之竞争的公司。奥尔特曼指出：“很多人的思维中都会出现一种想法，那就是他们只相信自己有能力开发这项技术，因为利害关系实在太大了。” 话虽如此，奥尔特曼仍然坚信 AI 将让人类迎来更美好的未来。他特别提到了基础科学研究，认为下一代 AI 模型能让科学持续进步。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 6, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said on the Raj Shamani podcast that AI could go out of control in two ways: humans gradually handing control to autonomous AI, or a single person or entity monopolizing AI technology. On the first, Altman warned: "AI will gradually slip out of control; we may intentionally or unintentionally hand control to systems far more capable than humans, and eventually be unable to take it back." On the second, he said the risk is monopoly: "Another scenario is one person, company, or country becoming too powerful relative to everyone else. Having multiple AI labs on different paths competing with each other is much safer than everyone depending on one company." The report says this concern about over-centralization explains why figures such as Musk and former OpenAI executives left to found competing companies. Altman noted: "Many people get the idea that they alone are capable of developing this technology, because the stakes are just too high." The report also notes Altman still believes AI will bring humanity a better future, citing basic scientific research in particular, and that next-generation AI models can keep science progressing.
items.why_zh: 推测：头部 AI 公司 CEO 在公开播客中谈"失控"与"反垄断"，可能影响业界对 AI 竞争格局与治理路径的讨论，但属个人表态而非政策承诺。
items.why_en: Speculative: a leading AI CEO publicly discussing loss of control and anti-monopoly concerns may shape industry debate on competition and governance, though these are personal remarks rather than policy commitments.

items.title_zh: 爱彼迎 Airbnb 计划明年推出 AI 智能体，帮助用户规划旅行
items.title_en: Airbnb plans to launch AI agent next year to help users plan trips
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据科技媒体 neowin 今天报道，民宿出租平台 Airbnb 爱彼迎在 2026 财年第三季度报告中透露，公司正开发全新 AI 智能体，计划 2027 年推出，可帮助用户规划旅行。 Airbnb 表示：“我们的智能体并没有采用传统聊天窗口，而是调用带有数百种旅行专用界面元素的资源库，它包含地图、照片、对比信息、日历和行程安排，可根据用户需求实时组合。 它将帮助房客探索不同选择 ，与同行者共同作出决定， 最终直接在 Airbnb 完成预订 。” 不过我们暂不清楚，Airbnb 的智能体究竟能带来怎样的独到优势。Airbnb 将 AI 称为公司发展过程中的最好机遇，并特别强调 AI 助手在处理客户支持问题方面发挥的作用。该公司表示，第三季度约有 40% 的客户支持请求无需人工客服介入，即可得到解决。
items.summary_en: According to a Nov 6 report by tech media Neowin, Airbnb revealed in its FY2026 third-quarter report that it is developing a new AI agent, planned for launch in 2027, to help users plan trips. Airbnb said the agent does not use a traditional chat window but calls on a resource library with hundreds of travel-specific interface elements, including maps, photos, comparison information, calendars, and itineraries, combining them in real time according to user needs. It will help guests explore options, make decisions with fellow travelers, and ultimately complete bookings directly on Airbnb. It is not yet clear what unique advantage Airbnb's agent will bring. Airbnb calls AI the company's best opportunity in its development and highlighted the role of AI assistants in handling customer support issues. The company said about 40% of customer support requests in the third quarter were resolved without human customer service intervention.
items.why_zh: 若按所述方向落地，可能改变旅行规划与预订入口，并影响在线旅行平台的交互方式（推测）。

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，美国股市今日开盘后，AI 硬件产业链全线反弹，费城半导体指数最高涨 6.57%。 个股方面，AMD 涨 13.2%，闪迪涨 11.75%，希捷科技涨 6.34%，美光科技涨 9.07%，迈威尔科技涨 9.46%，Lumentum 涨 9.58%；英伟达涨 6.44%，台积电涨 7.55%，博通涨 4.56%。 IT之家注意到， 美国股市 AI 概念相关股票当地时间周四迎来了暴跌 ，道琼斯工业平均指数收盘下跌超过 1,800 点，跌幅约 3.4%；标普 500 指数下跌 4.4%；纳斯达克综合指数暴跌 5.5%，创 2025 年 4 月以来最大单日跌幅，并跌入技术性回调区间。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 6 that after the US market opened today, the AI hardware supply chain rebounded across the board, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rising as much as 6.57%. Among individual stocks, AMD rose 13.2%, SanDisk rose 11.75%, Seagate Technology rose 6.34%, Micron Technology rose 9.07%, Marvell Technology rose 9.46%, and Lumentum rose 9.58%; Nvidia rose 6.44%, TSMC rose 7.55%, and Broadcom rose 4.56%. IT Home noted that US AI-concept stocks suffered a sharp selloff on Thursday local time: the Dow Jones Industrial Average closed down more than 1,800 points, or about 3.4%; the S&P 500 fell 4.4%; and the Nasdaq Composite plunged 5.5%, its largest single-day drop since April 2025, entering technical correction territory.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，荣耀产品维护与升级 @荣耀小芳哥 刚刚发布预告， 宣布今天 18 点开始，将向已报名 MagicOS 11 的第三批内测的用户增推版本 。 此外，下周一还将重新开放内测报名通道， 报名后次个工作日就可以收到版本 。推送机型如下： 手机： 荣耀 Robot Phone 、Magic Vs3、Magic V2 RSR 保时捷设计、Magic V2 至臻版、Magic V2、Magic5 至臻版、Magic5 Pro、Magic5、GT、300 Ultra、300 Pro、300、200 Pro、200、100 Pro、100、90 GT、Power、X80 Pro Max、X70 Pro Max、X70 焕新版、X70 平板：荣耀 MagicPad4、荣耀平板 20 5G 版、荣耀平板 20 柔光版、荣耀平板 20、荣耀平板 10 柔光版、荣耀平板 10 参考IT之家此前报道， 荣耀 MagicOS 11 系统第三批内测 log 版本，每个系列机型开放 2000 个名额 ，其中 log 版本 500 人、nolog 版本 1500 人。最终名额将根据报名情况进行适当调配，以最终公布的名单为准。 版本推送方面，荣耀说明首批推送 log 用户，nolog 用户将在下一个工作日推送。荣耀 Robot Phone 作为行业首款机器人手机，产品适配难度较高、工作量较大，本次首批仅招募 200 名 log 版本用户，协同工程师打磨版本体验。待版本质量稳定后，将陆续开放更多内测名额。
items.summary_en: IT Home, November 6: Honor’s product maintenance and upgrade account @荣耀小芳哥 just released a notice announcing that starting at 18:00 today, it will push an additional build to third-batch beta testers who have registered for MagicOS 11. items.title_en: China's NRTA launches a new round of special governance on micro-dramas, targeting content creation and distribution
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据央视新闻今日报道，近日，国家广播电视总局在巩固前期微短剧低俗有害和侵权盗版专项治理成效的基础上，针对 AI 微短剧质量良莠不齐、AI 技术助长低俗不良内容反弹等问题， 部署开展新一轮微短剧低俗化同质化专项治理工作 ，治理为期两个月，自 11 月 1 日起至 12 月底。 新一轮专项治理聚焦两个方面的突出问题： 内容创作方面 深化治理儿童类不良、软色情擦边、极端对立、拜金主义、严重违背家庭伦理道德等低俗不良内容； 治理未按要求备案审核的特殊题材内容；治理“盗脸”“偷声”问题，规范 AI 微短剧创作。 传播推广方面 治理片名、宣推素材、弹幕评论、引流片段中的低俗内容； 治理同一剧集通过更换片名或主角姓名等方式，改头换面、反复播出；治理首页首屏首推和重点榜单推荐同质化问题，提升算法推荐内容的多样性。 IT之家从报道获悉，今年以来，通过开展微短剧低俗有害内容和侵权盗版专项治理，累计下架违规微短剧 7.5 万部，处置违规账号 1500 余个。新一轮专项治理 聚焦 AI 技术助长低俗化同质化问题 ，进一步压实平台机构主体责任，规范平台及账号运营，推动行业生态持续净化。 在加强规范管理的同时，广电总局还会深入实施“微短剧精品创作传播计划”，通过资金扶持、创作引导、文艺评论、组织传播等工作机制， 提升微短剧的文化内涵、艺术品质和社会价值 ，以优秀作品持续涌现带动行业生态持续向好。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 6 — Citing CCTV News the same day, China's National Radio and Television Administration (NRTA) has launched a new two-month special governance campaign on low-quality and homogenized micro-dramas, running from Nov 1 to the end of December, building on earlier campaigns against vulgar/harmful content and piracy. The campaign targets two areas. On content creation: deeper action against harmful children's content, soft-core pornography, extreme antagonism, money worship and content seriously violating family ethics; unregistered or unreviewed content in special subject categories; and "face-stealing" and "voice-stealing" issues, in order to regulate AI-generated micro-dramas. On distribution and promotion: vulgar content in titles, promotional materials, bullet comments and trailer clips; the same series resurfacing repeatedly under changed titles or character names; and homogenized recommendations on homepages and key rankings, with a goal of improving the diversity of algorithm-recommended content. The report says that this year's campaigns have taken down 75,000 violating micro-dramas and handled more than 1,500 violating accounts. The new round focuses on how AI technology fuels vulgarization and homogenization and further presses platforms to fulfill their responsibilities. The NRTA will also implement a "micro-drama quality creation and distribution plan" through funding support, creative guidance, criticism and organized distribution to raise the cultural depth, artistic quality and social value of micro-dramas.
items.why_zh: 监管首次在本轮治理中明确将 AI 微短剧的“盗脸”“偷声”和低俗同质化列为治理对象，可能影响 AI 视频工具与内容平台的合规成本（推测）。
items.why_en: This round explicitly names AI micro-drama "face-stealing," "voice-stealing" and vulgar homogenization as targets, which could affect compliance costs for AI video tools and content platforms (speculative).

items.title_en: Day-0 support: Moore Threads completes adaptation of 3-trillion-parameter Kimi-K3.1 Pro, enabling text and image inference
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息， 本月 4 日，月之暗面正式公布 Kimi K3.1 Pro 完整模型权重 。在 Arena 运营的 Agent Arena 智能体排行榜中，Kimi K3.1 Pro（Max）位列开放权重模型第一、全部参评模型第 13 位，并在工作、编程与聊天三个类别中均居开放模型首位。 摩尔线程官方今日宣布，摩尔线程基于 AI 训推一体智算卡 MTT S5000 及 MUSA 软件栈， 完成 Kimi-K3.1 Pro 模型的 Day-0 适配 ，打通模型加载、服务启动及文本、图片基础推理链路。 IT之家了解到， Kimi K3.1 Pro 是 K3.1 系列首款模型 ，也是迄今能力最强的 3 万亿级参数模型，支持 100 万上下文。经过大规模后训练和强化学习，模型在代码、3D 创作、金融研究、知识问答及长程 Agent 任务等方面均全面提升；在代码与 Agent 基准测试中，其表现已达到或接近顶尖闭源模型水平：Terminal-Bench 4.0 得分 65.7%，Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon 得分 61.2%，高于 K3 的 55.95%。 摩尔线程官方表示，围绕 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的模型架构与计算特性，其通过 MUSA 软件栈，完成了关键推理路径迁移与适配，支持模型在 MTT S5000 上稳定运行。 MUSA 软件栈高兼容，支撑新模型快速迁移： MUSA 在编程模型、运行时接口和 AI 框架层面的快速兼容迁移能力，是本次快速适配的重要基础。团队基于 SGLang-MUSA 承接上游模型实现，并通过 MATE 算子库、Triton-MUSA、TileLang-MUSA 及 MTCC 编译器，完成新架构关键计算路径的迁移与接入，将社区模型代码转化为 MTT S5000 上的实际推理服务。MUSA 软件栈同时覆盖框架执行、算子编译、设备运行和多卡通信，使模型适配能够复用成熟接口，并针对新增计算路径开展优化。 接入 DSA，打通混合注意力与视觉计算： 针对 Kimi-K3.1 Pro 的稀疏注意力 DSA，MUSA 软件栈完成索引选择、KV 缓存布局及 Prefill、Decode 计算路径的适配，接入 MATE 稀疏注意力算子，并与 KDA 状态管理、跨层残差及视觉 Attention 共同组成完整执行链路。面对模型采用的 MXFP4 专家权重，团队通过在线转换与跨层复用 FP8 工作区的方式执行专家计算，无需预先生成完整的离线 FP8 权重，为超大模型快速部署提供支持。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 6 — On Nov 4, Moonshot AI officially released the full model weights of Kimi K3.1 Pro. On the Agent Arena leaderboard run by Arena, Kimi K3.1 Pro (Max) ranks first among open-weight models and 13th among all evaluated models, and tops open models in the work, coding and chat categories. Moore Threads announced that, using its MTT S5000 AI training-and-inference card and the MUSA software stack, it completed Day-0 adaptation of Kimi-K3.1 Pro, connecting model loading, service startup and basic text and image inference pipelines. Kimi K3.1 Pro is the first model in the K3.1 series and the most capable 3-trillion-parameter model to date, supporting a 1-million-token context; after large-scale post-training and reinforcement learning it improved across coding, 3D creation, financial research, knowledge Q&A and long-horizon agent tasks, and on coding and agent benchmarks it reaches or approaches leading closed-source models: Terminal-Bench 4.0 scored 65.7% and Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon 61.2%, above K3's 55.95%. Moore Threads said it migrated and adapted key inference paths through the MUSA stack for stable operation on MTT S5000. MUSA's fast compatibility at the programming-model, runtime-interface and AI-framework levels was an important basis; the team built on SGLang-MUSA for the upstream model implementation and used the MATE operator library, Triton-MUSA, TileLang-MUSA and the MTCC compiler to migrate and connect key compute paths of the new architecture, covering framework execution, operator compilation, device runtime and multi-card communication. For the model's sparse attention (DSA), MUSA adapted index selection, KV-cache layout and Prefill/Decode compute paths and integrated MATE sparse-attention operators, combining with KDA state management, cross-layer residuals and visual attention into a full execution chain; for MXFP4 expert weights, the team performed expert computation via online conversion and cross-layer reuse of an FP8 workspace, without pre-generating full offline FP8 weights.
items.why_zh: 国产 GPU 在超大规模开源权重模型发布当天完成适配，常被视作国产算力与软件栈成熟度的观察指标；但摘要内容来自厂商公告，尚缺第三方独立验证（推测）。
items.why_en: A domestic GPU vendor completing adaptation on the same day a very large open-weight model is released is often seen as a gauge of domestic compute-and-software-stack maturity; however, this summary comes from the vendor's own announcement and lacks independent third-party verification (speculative).

items.title_zh: 自然资源部：我国初步建成全国地质灾害监测预警网络
items.title_en: Ministry of Natural Resources: China has initially built a nationwide geological disaster monitoring and early-warning network
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据央视新闻今日报道，自然资源部中国地质调查局宣布，我国地质灾害监测预警体系建设成效显著， 已初步建成全国地质灾害监测预警网络 ，形成“人防 + 技防”立体化防治新格局。 截至 2026 年 9 月， 全国在运行自动化监测台站超 7.4 万个 ，各类监测设备 31 万台套，累计成功预报灾情 444 起， 避免人员伤亡 8027 人 。 据介绍，中国地质调查局持续提升地质灾害监测预警智能化水平，利用新技术增强地灾防范能力。通过将无人机自动巡航与 AI 智能分析结合，可提升复杂山区地灾巡查覆盖和隐患识别能力。针对山区局地强降雨多发特点，开展基于北斗卫星导航的区域短临降雨监测预报，北斗信号穿过大气时的微小变化，可精确感知大气中的水汽含量，从而预报降雨量和落点， 可实现设备周边约 3 公里、未来 6 小时的降雨预测 。 据IT之家此前报道，去年 5 月，自然资源部介绍称，我国通过构建“空天地”一体化监测技术体系，已成功实现对重大灾害隐患的主动防治。近年来，我国还在地质灾害隐患点安装了北斗滑坡监测仪、泥位计等传感器，实现对地质灾害风险的实时监控。其中， 北斗滑坡监测仪的地表形变测量精度可达毫米级 。 相关阅读： 《 我国构建“空天地”一体化地灾防治体系，北斗监测精度可达毫米级 》
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 6 — Citing CCTV News the same day, the China Geological Survey under the Ministry of Natural Resources announced that China's geological disaster monitoring and early-warning system has achieved notable results: a nationwide monitoring and early-warning network has been initially completed, forming a "human defense + technical defense" three-dimensional prevention framework. As of September 2026, more than 74,000 automated monitoring stations and 310,000 sets of monitoring equipment are in operation nationwide, with 444 disasters successfully forecast and 8,027 casualties avoided. The survey continues to make monitoring and early warning more intelligent: combining autonomous drone patrols with AI analysis can improve patrol coverage and hazard identification in complex mountainous areas; given frequent localized heavy rainfall in mountains, it conducts regional short-term rainfall monitoring and forecasting based on BeiDou satellite navigation — tiny changes in BeiDou signals passing through the atmosphere allow precise sensing of atmospheric water-vapor content, thereby forecasting rainfall amount and location, enabling rainfall prediction within about 3 km of the device and six hours ahead. The report notes that last May the ministry said China had achieved proactive prevention of major hazards through an integrated space-air-ground monitoring system, and had installed BeiDou landslide monitors, mud-level gauges and other sensors at hazard sites, with BeiDou landslide monitors measuring surface deformation to millimeter accuracy.
items.why_zh: AI 分析结合北斗短临降雨预报用于地灾预警，是 AI 进入公共安全基础设施的一个具体案例，其效果数据来自主管部门通报（推测）。
items.why_en: Combining AI analysis with BeiDou short-term rainfall forecasting for disaster early warning is a concrete case of AI entering public-safety infrastructure; the performance figures come from the responsible agency's own announcement (speculative).
items.source_title: 自然资源部：我国初步建成全国地质灾害监测预警网络
items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据央视新闻今日报道，自然资源部中国地质调查局宣布，我国地质灾害监测预警体系建设成效显著， 已初步建成全国地质灾害监测预警网络 ，形成“人防 + 技防”立体化防治新格局。 截至 2026 年 9 月， 全国在运行自动化监测台站超 7.4 万个 ，各类监测设备 31 万台套，累计成功预报灾情 444 起， 避免人员伤亡 8027 人 。 据介绍，中国地质调查局持续提升地质灾害监测预警智能化水平，利用新技术增强地灾防范能力。通过将无人机自动巡航与 AI 智能分析结合，可提升复杂山区地灾巡查覆盖和隐患识别能力。针对山区局地强降雨多发特点，开展基于北斗卫星导航的区域短临降雨监测预报，北斗信号穿过大气时的微小变化，可精确感知大气中的水汽含量，从而预报降雨量和落点， 可实现设备周边约 3 公里、未来 6 小时的降雨预测 。 据IT之家此前报道，去年 5 月，自然资源部介绍称，我国通过构建“空天地”一体化监测技术体系，已成功实现对重大灾害隐患的主动防治。近年来，我国还在地质灾害隐患点安装了北斗滑坡监测仪、泥位计等传感器，实现对地质灾害风险的实时监控。其中， 北斗滑坡监测仪的地表形变测量精度可达毫米级 。 相关阅读： 《 我国构建“空天地”一体化地灾防治体系，北斗监测精度可达毫米级 》

items.title_zh: Brightspeed 与英伟达洽谈，计划将 130 多座老旧电信建筑改造为小型数据中心
items.title_en: Brightspeed in talks with Nvidia to convert more than 130 old telecom buildings into small data centers
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据 The Information 报道，互联网电信服务提供商 Brightspeed 正与英伟达洽谈，计划将多座老旧电信建筑改造为小型数据中心。 IT之家从原报道获悉， 英伟达曾在此前向 Brightspeed 母公司阿波罗全球管理提出这一设想 ，后来他们要求英伟达提交书面方案。英伟达目前已按要求提交，正进一步获取相关信息，并希望实地考察这些建筑。 Brightspeed 在美国拥有约 130 座建筑， 其中大部分用于处理数据和语音通信流量 。英伟达预计这些设施合计可提供约 1 吉瓦的算力，能容纳 2200 多个 Supermicro Vera Rubin NVL72 机柜。每个机柜包含 72 颗 Rubin GPU 和 36 颗 Vera CPU。 尽管这些设施的现有供电能力已经能满足 GPU 运行需求， 但改造工作并非简单地安装设备即可完成 ，英伟达仍需部署冷却系统及其他配套基础设施。上述改造项目依然需要获得许可和地方政府批准，不过与从零开始建设数据中心相比，改造具备审批程序少、社区反对较低的优点。 此外，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 也一直在考虑建设多个类似的小型数据中心，尤其是在大型数据中心项目不断遭遇延期和当地社区反对的情况下。对于 AI 模型训练而言，在同一地点建设规模庞大、架构统一的计算集群仍然是更理想的选择。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 6 — According to The Information, internet and telecom service provider Brightspeed is in talks with Nvidia to convert several old telecom buildings into small data centers. IT之家 learns from the original report that Nvidia previously floated the idea to Brightspeed's parent company Apollo Global Management, which later asked Nvidia to submit a written proposal; Nvidia has now done so and is gathering further information and wants to visit the buildings. Brightspeed owns about 130 buildings in the US, most used to handle data and voice traffic. Nvidia estimates the facilities could together provide about 1 gigawatt of compute and house more than 2,200 Supermicro Vera Rubin NVL72 racks, each containing 72 Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs. Although existing power capacity can already meet GPU needs, the conversion is not simply a matter of installing equipment — Nvidia would still need to deploy cooling systems and other supporting infrastructure. The projects still require permits and local government approval, but compared with building data centers from scratch, conversions involve fewer approvals and less community opposition. OpenAI and Anthropic have also been considering multiple similar small data centers, especially as large data-center projects face delays and local opposition. For AI model training, the report notes, large, architecturally uniform compute clusters in one location remain the more ideal choice.
items.why_zh: 把存量电信机房改造为小型数据中心，反映 AI 算力扩张正尝试绕开新建项目的审批与社区阻力，但该计划仍处洽谈阶段，尚未确认（推测）。
items.why_en: Converting existing telecom facilities into small data centers reflects efforts to expand AI compute while sidestepping approvals and community opposition that new builds face; the plan is still in talks and unconfirmed (speculative).

items.title_en: Protesters break into Microsoft data center site in Amsterdam
items.summary_zh: 抗议者今晨闯入阿姆斯特丹一处新建微软数据中心的施工现场。行动组织 Geef Tegengas 的成员参与组织了这场反对在阿姆斯特丹郊外建造三座 85 米高数据中心塔楼的抗议。路透社报道称，约 100 人进入工地，其中一些人爬上起重机悬挂写有“fuck AI”的横幅。抗议者还在工地展开写有“Microsoft powers genocide”的横幅，并高喊“Microsoft has got to go”和“free Palestine”。反对该数据中心的声音出现在该市禁止新建数据中心一年多之后……完整报道见 The Verge。（配图说明：抗议期间，行动组织 Geef Tegengas 的成员在起重机上悬挂横幅。图片来源：Getty Images）
items.summary_en: Members of the action group Geef Tegengas put a banner on a crane during a protest. | Image: Getty Images Protesters have broken into a construction site of a new Microsoft data center in Amsterdam this morning. Members of the Geef Tegengas group helped organize the protest against the construction of three 85-meter data center towers in the outskirts of Amsterdam. Reuters reports that around 100 people made it into the construction site, with some scaling a crane to place a "fuck AI" banner. Protesters also unfurled a "Microsoft powers genocide" banner on the construction site, and chanted "Microsoft has got to go" and "free Palestine." items.title_zh: 吉利星愿 STAR 限定系列 Ace / Chill 上市，限时权益价 8.88 万元
items.title_en: Geely Xingyuan STAR limited series Ace and Chill launched at a limited-time price of 88,800 yuan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日现场消息，2026 吉利银河全球用户大会今晚举行，吉利星愿 STAR 限定系列 Ace 和 Chill 车型上市， 限时权益价 8.88 万元 。 新车增加电动前备箱与 EVA 机器人，同时带来更加丰富的车型阵容、车色与内饰选择。 IT之家在现场获悉，STAR Ace 提供无忧绿、百事橙、流光银三种车色；STAR Chill 采用奶盐米车色并搭配全新内饰。 STAR Ace 配备专属运动外观套件，涵盖运动前扰流板、运动星际尾翼、铝合金运动轮毂、STAR 专属徽标、熏黑运动车标等多项外观专属配件。 内饰方面，STAR Ace 搭配曜石黑专属内饰，以黑红、黑橙两款撞色设计；STAR Chill 搭配沐光米专属内饰。 车身尺寸方面，STAR Ace 长宽高为 4155×1805×1570mm，STAR Chill 长宽高为 4135×1805×1570mm，轴距均为 2650mm；配备 70L 双气动撑杆超大前备箱和 375-1320L 后备箱空间。 新车全系采用宁德时代电芯和液冷技术 + 神盾电池安全防护系统，搭载 11 合 1 智能电驱，并搭载星睿 AI 云动力 2.0。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 6, reporting on site — At the 2026 Geely Galaxy global user conference that evening, the Geely Xingyuan STAR limited series Ace and Chill models were launched at a limited-time price of 88,800 yuan. The new cars add an electric front trunk and an EVA robot, along with a broader lineup and more color and interior options. STAR Ace comes in Wuyou Green, Pepsi Orange and Liuguang Silver; STAR Chill uses a Milk Salt Beige color with a new interior. STAR Ace has a dedicated sporty exterior package including a sport front spoiler, sport interstellar rear wing, aluminum alloy sport wheels, a STAR badge and a blacked-out sport emblem. Inside, STAR Ace gets an exclusive obsidian-black interior in black-red or black-orange two-tone designs, while STAR Chill gets an exclusive Muguang Beige interior. Dimensions: STAR Ace is 4155×1805×1570mm and STAR Chill 4135×1805×1570mm, both with a 2650mm wheelbase; they offer a 70L front trunk with dual pneumatic struts and 375-1320L of rear cargo space. All versions use CATL cells with liquid cooling plus the ShenDun battery safety system, an 11-in-1 intelligent electric drive, and Xingrui AI Cloud Power 2.0.
items.why_zh: 该车型搭载“星睿 AI 云动力 2.0”与 EVA 机器人等配置，属于车企以 AI 功能做产品差异化的案例；其实际体验尚未在摘要中体现（推测）。
items.why_en: The car features "Xingrui AI Cloud Power 2.0" and an EVA robot, an example of automakers using AI features for product differentiation; its real-world performance is not covered in the summary (speculative).

items.title_zh: 我观看一台人形机器人打扫了我的公寓，感觉像提前尝到了未来
items.title_en: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
items.summary_zh: 作者自称平时不会花钱请保洁，但在 X 上看到旧金山一项新的人形机器人清洁服务后，立刻加入了等候名单，想让公寓有一小时“杰森一家”的感觉；同时出于新闻兴趣，为保持体验真实，作者没有向这家名为 Tau Robotics 的初创公司表明记者身份（但使用了真名，因此可能被人查到）。Tau 的长期目标是让自主清洁机器人成为现实，但目前尚未达到：机器人仍由人类远程操控，操作者通过装在机器人头部和手腕上的摄像头观察现场。机器人在清洁过程中采集数据，Tau 将用这些数据训练未来更独立的“后代”。由于数据对 Tau 很有价值，其清洁收费低于外界对这类前沿产品的预期：作者预订时，一台机器人清洁一小时为 30 美元；现在价格为两台机器人每周清洁 60 美元，或一次性上门 100 美元。但即便按每小时 30 美元，Tau 的机器人也并不划算：它们细致但缓慢，如果像作者那样全程站在旁边观看，不如自己动手打扫。不过机器人确实具备清洁能力，而且不可否认地可爱。
items.summary_en: I’m not the sort of person who typically pays for a house cleaner. I’m too frugal, and I kind of enjoy putting on a podcast and going to town on my tub with a Magic Eraser. But when I saw an X post about a new humanoid-robot cleaning service in San Francisco, I immediately signed up for the waitlist. I wanted my apartment to feel like The Jetsons , even if just for an hour. I was also motivated by journalistic interest. In order to ensure an authentic experience, I didn’t tell Tau Robotics, the startup behind the X post, that I was a journalist—though I did use my real name, so it’s possible someone looked me up. Tau’s long-term goal is to make autonomous cleaning robots a reality, but they’re not quite there yet: For now, the robots are piloted remotely by humans, who watch what’s going on via cameras mounted in the robots’ heads and wrists. As the robots clean, they collect data that Tau will use to train up their more independent descendants. Every counter successfully wiped and T-shirt successfully folded will help the models that power the robots learn to do better on the next go-round. Because this data is so valuable to Tau, the company charges less for cleaning than one might expect for such a cutting-edge product. At the time I booked, Tau was offering $30 for an hourlong cleaning with a single robot; now the charge is $60 per weekly cleaning with two robots, or $100 for a one-time visit. But even at the cheaper rate of $30 per hour, Tau’s robots aren’t a great bargain. They are thorough but slow, so if you, like me, are tempted to stand around watching them for their entire visit, it would probably be a better use of your time to just take care of the cleaning yourself. But the robots are physically capable of cleaning, and they’re undeniably cute. Tau has arm…
items.why_zh: 家用机器人仍靠人工遥操作、并以采集数据反哺模型训练，说明这一消费级机器人商业化路径目前依赖人工与数据飞轮；这是单个用户体验，非产品评测结论（推测）。
items.why_en: Home robots still rely on remote human teleoperation and on collecting data to feed model training, suggesting the consumer robotics path currently depends on human labor and a data flywheel; this is one user's experience, not a product-review conclusion (speculative).

items.title_en: Report: OPPO's product strategy to be more focused; phones to push wide form factor, gimbal camera codenamed 'Fuyao' coming
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，博主 @数码闲聊站 今日发文透露，某厂 2027 年的产品策略更聚焦了， 手机发力阔形态 ，AI 和阔形态上应该能做出新东西。从评论区讨论及暗示表情来看，预计指 OPPO。 另外，博主表示，影像也会有新形态产品， 代号「扶摇」的云台相机应该快了 ，内部还挺有信心。 据IT之家此前报道，该博主曾透露，OPPO 的 6.35 英寸阔直板产品线，明年首款新机属于高端旗舰线，后续考虑下放轻薄拍照机。该机是标准 16:9 比例，工程机测试天玑旗舰芯、3D 超声波指纹，屏幕分辨率为 2560*1440p， 采用 LIPO 极窄四等边设计 ，目测边框 1mm±，机身宽度大概是 81mm。 另外，今年 6 月有消息称， OPPO 和 vivo 的手持 Pocket 云台相机将采用 200Mp 1/1.12" 超级大底主摄 ，有望与哈苏 / 蔡司联名，内置“旗舰级”芯片，支持生态互联，无缝存图修图发图。同时，荣耀的 Robot Phone 手机内置可折叠云台臂 +200Mp 4DoF 云台主摄 + 端侧大模型，与“阿莱”影像联名。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov. 6: Blogger @DigitalChatStation posted today that a certain manufacturer's 2027 product strategy is more focused, with phones pushing the wide form factor, and that new things should be possible in AI and the wide form factor. Judging from comment discussions and hinting emojis, it is expected to refer to OPPO. In addition, the blogger said there will also be new-form-factor imaging products, and the gimbal camera codenamed "Fuyao" should be coming soon, with the internal team quite confident. According to previous IT Home reports, the blogger once revealed that OPPO's 6.35-inch wide bar-phone product line will have its first new model next year in the high-end flagship line, and later it is considering bringing it down to thin-and-light camera phones. The device has a standard 16:9 ratio; engineering units are testing a Dimensity flagship chip and 3D ultrasonic fingerprint, with a 2560*1440p screen resolution, LIPO ultra-narrow four-sided equal-width bezel design, visually estimated bezel of 1mm±, and body width of about 81mm. In addition, news in June this year said OPPO and vivo's handheld Pocket gimbal cameras will use a 200MP 1/1.12-inch ultra-large main camera, potentially with Hasselblad / Zeiss co-branding, a built-in "flagship-level" chip, ecosystem interconnection support, and seamless image saving, editing and posting. Meanwhile, Honor's Robot Phone has a built-in foldable gimbal arm + 200MP 4DoF gimbal main camera + on-device large model, with "ARRI" imaging co-branding.
items.why_zh: 推测：若爆料属实，OPPO 可能在手机形态和云台相机上同时探索新品类，但信息来自博主爆料，尚未获官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the leak is accurate, OPPO may be exploring new categories in both phone form factors and gimbal cameras, but the information comes from a blogger's leak and has not been officially confirmed.

items.title_zh: 今日宜休鸿蒙版适配进度落后，王腾透露华为开发团队特意拉了小群来支持
items.title_en: Jinri Yixiu's HarmonyOS adaptation lags; Wang Teng says Huawei dev team set up a dedicated group to support it
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，今日宜休科技公司创始人今日发文，称今日宜休鸿蒙版的适配进度落后。不过他透露， 华为开发团队特意拉了小群来支持今日宜休 。 王腾表示，目前今日宜休在华为手机上卓易通版本已经上线，而纯血鸿蒙版正在开发中。 有网友询问今日宜休准备什么时候接入米家智能？王腾表示：“ 我们会开放 MCP，各家的 AI 都可以调用。 ”还有网友询问如果实物到手后尺寸不合适是否可以申请换货？王腾回复称：“ 7 天无理由退换货。 ” 据IT之家此前报道，今年 9 月，今日宜休 ISHO 睡眠记录 App 开启内测， 首期内测仅支持苹果 iOS，并且需要佩戴苹果 Apple Watch 。今年 10 月底，王腾宣布 ISHO App 正式上线，支持睡眠数据查看、精力评分、个性化睡眠建议与生态设备联动。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov. 6: The founder of Jinri Yixiu Technology posted today that Jinri Yixiu's HarmonyOS version adaptation is behind schedule. However, he revealed that Huawei's development team specifically set up a small group to support Jinri Yixiu. Wang Teng said that Jinri Yixiu's Zhuoyitong version has already launched on Huawei phones, while the native HarmonyOS version is under development. A netizen asked when Jinri Yixiu plans to integrate with Mijia smart home. Wang Teng said: "We will open MCP, so AI from various companies can call it." Another netizen asked whether they can apply for an exchange if the physical product's size does not fit after arrival. Wang Teng replied: "7-day no-reason return or exchange." According to previous IT Home reports, in September this year, the Jinri Yixiu ISHO sleep tracking app opened beta testing; the first beta only supported Apple iOS and required wearing an Apple Watch. At the end of October this year, Wang Teng announced that the ISHO App was officially launched, supporting sleep data viewing, energy scores, personalized sleep suggestions and ecosystem device integration.
items.why_zh: 推测：若鸿蒙适配持续落后，可能影响今日宜休在华为生态中的可用性；但进度和华为支持来自创始人说法，尚无华为官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculation: if HarmonyOS adaptation continues to lag, it could affect Jinri Yixiu's usability in Huawei's ecosystem; however, the progress and Huawei's support come from the founder's account and have not been officially confirmed by Huawei.
